---
name: Work item
about: A concrete problem, intended outcome and relevant evidence
---

## Problem and intended outcome

Describe who is affected and what should change. Include a concrete example or
reproduction when useful.

## Acceptance

What observable behavior would resolve this issue? Note any relevant consumer,
platform or scientific constraints and dependencies.

## Evidence

Link existing checks or observations. Distinguish remaining implementation from
release, consumer or human/device acceptance when those are part of the scope.
